name: dimension_that_keeps_the_slot_inside
why: THE TWIN of `limit_dimension_that_pushes_the_slot_out` (entry E18 part c, and the rule of Z-C11). Same plate, same slot, but the dimension goes down only to 180: the plate runs from X -100 to +80 and the slot (X -60..+60) stays inside. A guard that refused this one too would refuse every change to a plate with a slot: it would look like caution, and it is an operation that always says no.

expect.tolerance_why: 480000 minus (100*20 + pi*10^2) * 20 = 46283.19: the slot of `slot` has true semicircles (measured on `slot/blind_slot`: 535.0332 for 5). Half a cubic millimetre covers pi
180*120*20 = 432000 minus the WHOLE slot, 46283.19. If the slot had come out even a little, a piece of it would be missing and the volume would be higher
the bounding box is read in metres from the body: the hundredth is rounding
